protocol: Sequential fresh workers, rotating case order. One output verification, two warmups, three timed batches; two exports per bulk batch, 50 tiny. Natural GC, no profiling/forced GC. Counting Node writable; planning, generation, encoding/ZIP and completion included; imports/connection excluded from time. Peak RSS is whole-process including imports/warmups/repeated exports. Fixed 256-row SQL batches, 64 KiB writer and yields every 2048 rows. ZIP level 1, memLevel 9, 256 KiB compression output chunks. Each package build uses its own ZIP/checksum implementation; manual JS uses the installed zip-stream. Plain bytes independently match csv-stringify and parse to original fixture values. All before/after and same-name manual archive hashes match. JSON-mode initializes the same Drizzle driver/schema for package and manual workers; manual JS still reads driver rows directly and parses/stringifies JSON to match native canonical cells. ESM is the default for both package and schema imports. Pre-export setup RSS and its high-water mark are recorded separately. CPU usage includes process threads.
